Product Details: The DIY Solar Wooden Windmill Assembled Kit is an educational and eco-friendly project designed for students, hobbyists, and STEM enthusiasts. This kit includes pre-cut wooden pieces, a small solar panel, and a motor, allowing users to build a fully functional windmill powered by solar energy. With easy-to-assemble parts, it introduces basic engineering concepts, renewable energy principles, and hands-on creativity. As sunlight hits the high-efficiency solar panel, it generates electricity to power the motor, which in turn rotates the windmill blades, demonstrating solar energy conversion in real-time. The wooden frame is crafted from high-quality, non-toxic, and environmentally friendly materials, ensuring durability while being safe for kids and adults alike. No batteries or external power sources are needed, making it an excellent tool for understanding sustainable energy. This DIY windmill kit is perfect for school science projects, classroom learning, or as a fun home activity. It enhances problem-solving skills, fine motor skills, and creativity while fostering an interest in green technology. Once assembled, it can be displayed as a decorative piece or used as a working model to showcase the power of solar energy. Suitable for all ages, this kit provides a fun and educational experience while promoting awareness of renewable energy.
